einzeiler: Kenny Hamp faces felony charges until the DA uncovers evidence of parental fabrication.
kurzfassung: Kenny Hamp faced felony child abuse charges after an ex-husband accused him of assaulting his son in Steamboat Springs, Colorado. Numerous medical exams found no serious injuries, and subsequent forensic interviews revealed clear signs of parental coaching. District Attorney Matt Carson ultimately dismissed all criminal charges against Kenny after concluding he was likely framed.
stichpunkte: Kenny Hamp was initially charged with misdemeanor child abuse, which was later escalated to a felony carrying up to 16 years in prison.
Multiple medical professionals and a sexual assault nurse examiner found no evidence of serious injury despite extensive doctor shopping.
Kenny rejected a plea deal because admitting guilt would brand him as a child sexual predator.
District Attorney Matt Carson ordered a second round of forensic interviews after noticing suspicious inconsistencies in the children's statements.
The second interviews and case evidence strongly indicated that the allegations were fabricated and coached by the boys' father, Steve.
District Attorney Matt Carson dropped all criminal charges against Kenny in June 2020 upon realizing he may have been framed.
Despite the criminal dismissal, a family court judge later ruled in a custody hearing that inappropriate contact had occurred.
Kenny and Cindy subsequently filed a civil lawsuit against Steve to clear their names and hold him accountable.
